nativeApp.intro: You are using the Clara app for iPhone: the same Clara as on the web, inside an app installed from Xcode.
nativeApp.data.title: Where your data lives
nativeApp.data.text: On this iPhone, inside the app. Clara in Safari and Clara on the Home Screen keep their own data separately: what you record here does not show up there, or the other way round.
nativeApp.bring.title: Bring your data from the web version
nativeApp.bring.step1: In the Clara that has your data (Safari or the one on the Home Screen), open Settings › {backup} and tap “{export}”.
nativeApp.bring.step2: Save the file in the Files app.
nativeApp.bring.step3: Here, open Settings › {backup}, tap “{import}” and choose that file.
nativeApp.update.title: How it updates
nativeApp.update.text: It does not update by itself or from the App Store: it is installed again from Xcode, on the Mac (the steps are in docs/IOS-NATIVE.md in the project). Installing over it keeps your data; deleting the app erases it.
nativeApp.expiry.title: It stops opening after 7 days
nativeApp.expiry.text: With a free Apple account, the app expires 7 days after it is installed. The fix is to install it again from Xcode, without deleting it from the iPhone: your data is still there.
nativeApp.backupFirst: Before updating or reinstalling, export a backup.
install.title: Clara on this iPhone
shell.leaveDemoText: The fictitious data in the app will be deleted and you will start the setup with your own data.
shell.corruptText: The data saved in the app is damaged or incomplete. Download a copy before starting over; an internal copy will also be kept.
shell.corruptConfirmText: The app will be empty. If you have not downloaded the data yet, do it first: an internal copy is kept in the app only if there is space.
shell.newerText: It was saved by a newer version of Clara than the one installed on this iPhone. Nothing was changed. Install the new version from Xcode to use it.
shell.newerHint: This happens when an older version is installed over a newer one.
settings.backup.text: Create a file with all your data. Keep it somewhere safe: it contains financial information. It is the only copy that survives losing this iPhone or deleting the app; automatic local copies live inside the app.
settings.storage.local: Your data is stored only on this iPhone, inside the Clara app.
settings.storage.lost: If you delete the app from this iPhone, it’s lost. Export backups regularly.
settings.storage.noSync: It doesn’t sync with other devices or with Clara on the web yet.
settings.storage.eviction: iOS can empty the internal storage of the app’s web view when space runs low. The automatic local copies, the PIN lock and this device’s preferences still live there: do not rely on them as your only copy, and export your own.
settings.storage.notEncrypted: Clara adds no encryption or password of its own: anyone who can unlock this iPhone can see the data. Use a passcode on the iPhone.
settings.storage.backend.indexeddb: The app could not use its own file and is saving to IndexedDB, the web view’s internal storage, which iOS can empty when space runs low. Export a backup.
settings.reset.clearText: All your accounts, movements, scheduled payments, goals, history and drafts will be removed from the app. Automatic local copies (Settings › Local copies), this device’s preferences and the files you exported are kept. This cannot be undone. Export a copy first if you need one.
settings.theme.hint: "System" follows your iPhone setting. It is remembered on this device.
setup.welcome.privacyTitle: Your data stays on this iPhone
setup.welcome.privacyText: There’s no user account and no connection to your bank. If you delete the app it’s lost, and it doesn’t sync across devices yet. You can export backups.
welcome.restore.hint: Already used Clara in Safari, on the Home Screen or on another phone? Export a backup there and import it here.
backup.localNotBackup: Saving on this iPhone is not a backup: if you delete the app or change phones, it is lost. Keep the exported file somewhere else (your cloud, your computer…).
home.backup.textNever: You have never exported your data. If you delete the app or lose the iPhone, it is lost.
account.guestText: Clara works without an account. Everything you record is on this iPhone; if you lose it or delete the app, it is gone unless you have backups.
save.error.conflict: The saved data changed: not saved
save.problem.quota: The iPhone is out of space. What was saved before is intact, but what you see now will be lost if you close the app. Download a copy, free up space on the iPhone and try again.
save.problem.unavailable: iOS did not allow writing the data file. What was saved before is intact, but what you see now will be lost when you close the app. Download a copy so you do not lose it.
save.problem.conflict: The data file changed after you opened the app. To avoid erasing anything, nothing was saved here. If you need what you just did, download a copy before loading the saved data.
save.problem.unknown: The app did not confirm the save. What was saved before is intact, but what you see now will be lost if you close the app.
save.problem.loadSaved: Load the saved data (discards what you see)
localBackup.intro: Every 24 h while the app is open (if something changed), before restoring or deleting, and whenever you ask. The 10 most recent are kept inside the app.
localBackup.notRemote: A local backup lives inside the app, in internal storage that iOS can empty when space runs low: if that happens, or you delete the app or lose the iPhone, it is gone. Export a file to keep it elsewhere.
localBackup.unavailable: The app cannot use its internal storage right now: no automatic local backups.
lock.notEncryption: It is a screen barrier, not encryption: it does not protect the data file, and exported backups carry no PIN.
lock.sectionIntro: Asks for a PIN when Clara opens and after 60 seconds in the background. If this iPhone has it set up, Face ID or Touch ID too.
lock.addBiometric: Use Face ID or Touch ID
lock.useBiometric: Use Face ID or Touch ID
lock.biometricOn: Face ID or Touch ID enabled on this iPhone.
lock.biometricRegistered: Face ID or Touch ID enabled
lock.biometricNotRegistered: It was not enabled (cancelled, no permission, or not set up on the iPhone). The PIN stays active.
lock.biometricUnavailable: Face ID or Touch ID is not available right now (not set up on the iPhone, or Clara has no permission in the iPhone’s Settings): PIN only.
lock.storageFailed: Could not store the lock in the app.
lock.forgotText: Clara has no account or server that could reset it. Without the PIN, the only way out is deleting the app and installing it again, which deletes Clara’s data: restore an exported backup afterwards.
data.intro: One place to know where your data lives, what protects it and, if something fails, in what order to recover it. Everything lives on this iPhone, inside the app: no account and no sync.
data.limits: Clara does not sync or store anything outside this iPhone: if you delete the app or lose the phone, only what you exported can be recovered.
data.row.localCopies.warn: The app cannot keep automatic local copies right now
data.row.preMigration.ok: Copy from before the migration to schema {version}, kept in the app
data.row.preMigration.info: No pre-migration copy (no migration was needed here)
data.step.localCopies: Restore an automatic local copy from the app
safety.text: Clara keeps everything only on this iPhone, with no server. An exported backup is what you have left if you lose the phone or delete the app.
assistant.voiceUnavailable: Dictation is not available in the iPhone app yet. Type the text.
assistant.photoNoOcr: The iPhone app cannot read text in photos yet. You can still attach the photo and type the total; nothing is sent anywhere.
assistant.hint.ocrUnavailable: The iPhone app cannot read text in photos yet: the photo stays attached and the amount is typed by hand.
assistantSettings.voiceOff: Dictation: not available in the iPhone app yet.
assistantSettings.ocrOff: Receipt photos: the iPhone app cannot read text in photos yet; they can still be attached.
settings.notifications.permission.unsupp: The iPhone app does not send system notifications yet: notices appear inside the app.
settings.backup.exportedNotRecorded: The backup went out through “Share”, but it could not be noted in the backup log (out of space?). Check that it was saved (for example, in Files).
backup.lastExportNote: The app created the file and opened the Share sheet. It cannot check where it was saved or whether you keep it.
backup.lightExported: Backup without photos: the Share sheet opened. It is not recorded as a backup.
